title: Case-directed ff/rf fingertip-to-pen transfer audit
hypothesis: Coherent forefinger and ring-finger circumferential motion transfers to pen roll, producing more progress when aligned with each case's existing roll than when opposed.

prediction.rationale: Define progress as integrated pen axial angular velocity over steps 150–209, signed by the zero-cell mean roll direction over steps 120–149; the primary statistic is the mean paired pro-minus-anti difference in radians with a two-sided 95% case-level t interval. A 0.10-rad difference is the minimum predicted transfer. Unlike deferred R-098, this is a finite audit of the two fingers that tracked post hoc in D-069, not a decoder qualification or controller repair; D-069's failed all-finger gate does not settle this contrast. Predeclare eligibility using only the zero-cell prefix: retained through step 149 and absolute mean roll rate at least 0.25 rad/s, with at least 20 eligible cases required. Authority is adequate only if, separately for ff and rf, at least 80% of eligible cases have positive signed pro-minus-anti achieved fingertip circumferential displacement, its 95% case-level t interval excludes zero positively, and median displacement divided by 2 × 0.02 m/s × 0.5 s is at least 0.30. Use fingertip world velocity projected into the pen-axis circumferential basis, not fingertip-minus-surface velocity, for this authority check. This 120-episode audit ranks first because it separates authority failure from failed object transfer cheaply. REVISION (triage round 1, agreed): Three frozen cells on the one manifest, each a fresh process: 'zero' (the incumbent with a zero-request residual, which must return the incumbent's action exactly), 'coherent_pos' and 'coherent_neg' (the R-097 frozen block unchanged, +/-0.02 m/s circumferential requested on the forefinger and ring fingertips together, every other fingertip request zero). Pro/anti is assigned per case after the fact from the zero-cell sign: by contact_control's convention a fingertip moving along +circumferential rolls the pen positively about its +X, so the pro cell is coherent_pos where the zero-cell mean axial rate over steps 120-149 is positive and coherent_neg otherwise. A significantly negative pro-minus-anti is reported as transfer of the opposite sign, not as support. Termination: progress integrates the original episode only over steps 150-209, a step at or after the case's end contributes zero, autoreset motion is never read, and no case is filtered on pulse-arm survival. In-play prefixes through step 149 must be bit-identical across the three cells or the audit is void. Telemetry per pulse arm: decoder speed bound, joint-limit bound, cap and downstream action clamp fractions separately on the ff and rf chains, incumbent action saturation, joint motion, fingertip world velocity, pen-surface velocity and their difference. The env has no contact sensor: contact impulses are listed as unavailable, not estimated.

An interval containing zero establishes no directional improvement; inadequate authority or fewer than 20 eligible cases makes the transfer question inconclusive rather than refuted. Report these outcomes separately.

posthoc_contact_distance.note: Post hoc, not predeclared. Distance from each fingertip link origin to the ideal pen capsule surface (mm), from the cells' own recorded observations (contact_control.capsule_frames). The pen radius is 12 mm; a touching fingertip reads about 11-12 mm.

result.notes: 120 episodes (3 cells x 40, seed 4750), 0 LLM generation calls, about 2 minutes of Isaac. The first launch ran the driver under the wrong Python environment and failed before any episode; relaunched under the Isaac environment with nothing changed. Authority is adequate by the declared rule (ff 0.69, rf 0.82 of the full 20 mm; every eligible case positive; no speed bound, cap or action clamp active, joint-limit bound on 0.11 of ff steps in the + cell only). Roll progress pro minus anti over steps 150-209: -0.054 rad [-0.147, +0.038], 32 eligible cases; the upper bound is below the predicted +0.10. Pen-surface displacement under the fingertips was 1.4 mm (ff) and 0.5 mm (rf) against 14 mm of fingertip travel. Post hoc explanation, not predeclared: the forefinger, ring and little fingertips are never within 15 mm of the pen surface under this incumbent (median about 58 mm away from step 100 on); only the middle fingertip and thumb are at the surface (within 15 mm on 0.92 and 0.89 of steps). The two fingers that tracked in D-069 were moving in free space. Contact impulses unavailable (no contact sensor); contact is inferred from link-origin distance to an ideal capsule.

verdicts.reasoning: With adequate ff/rf authority by the declared rule (median 0.69 and 0.82 of the full displacement, all 32 eligible cases positive, intervals far above zero), pro-minus-anti roll progress is -0.054 rad [-0.147, +0.038]: the upper bound is below the predicted +0.10, so the predicted transfer is refuted as declared; prefixes are bit-identical and the zero cell equals the incumbent. Scope: this refutes roll transfer through coherent forefinger/ring circumferential motion under this incumbent's grasp, with this decoder and one 0.5 s, 0.02 m/s pulse. Post hoc (not predeclared, from recorded observations): those fingertips are about 58 mm from the pen surface throughout, and only the middle fingertip and thumb are at the surface, so the audited fingers had nothing to transfer to; D-069's ff/rf tracking was free-space motion. It does not test the fingers that hold the pen.
verdicts.next_experiment: Run R-102 as agreed. Any further contact-interface work on this incumbent has to act on the middle finger and thumb, which D-069 showed do not track and which are partly saturated; that is a new direction, not a follow-up under this one.

verdicts.reasoning: The named anti-direction control was measured, both prefix and zero-action identity checks had maximum absolute differences of 0.0, and authority was reported adequate across 32 eligible cases [logs/pen_spin/r101_transfer_audit/summary.json]. The paired signed_goal_progress difference was -0.0544 rad, with a 95% interval of [-0.1468, +0.0380] rad [logs/pen_spin/r101_transfer_audit/summary.json]. Its upper bound is below the predicted +0.10-rad increase, satisfying the predeclared magnitude-refutation criterion [logs/pen_spin/r101_transfer_audit/summary.json]. Because the interval includes zero, neither directional improvement nor opposite-sign transfer is established; this refutes the specified transfer magnitude, not every possible transfer effect [logs/pen_spin/r101_transfer_audit/summary.json].
verdicts.next_experiment: Now that the audit is complete, re-triage the existing R-102 unchanged-residual confirmation with its 1,344-episode, zero-LLM budget; do not extend this transfer audit.

direction: No LLM calls in any protocol. Two finite follow-ups to D-069 and D-070 on Stage 3, on the fixed-stroke incumbent (config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent). (A) A transfer audit: on about 40 fresh cases, run the incumbent alone and with forefinger/ring circumferential pulses along and against each case's own roll direction, logging clamp activity, joint motion, fingertip and pen-surface velocity, and contact impulses; the prediction is on paired roll progress, pro minus anti. (B) One confirmatory replication of D-070's frozen residual, unchanged, on about 670 fresh pairs against the incumbent, with the strict paired success rule and the drop bound. No retuning, no new controller search, no further replication after (B). One protocol at a time on the box.

advisor.reasoning: This is the right first spend: 120 simulator episodes and 0 LLM calls can separate ff/rf authority failure from failed pen transfer, which D-069's all-finger gate did not settle. The signed_goal_progress prediction is an increase of at least 0.10 rad versus same-manifest anti-direction pulses; with adequate authority, an upper 95% bound below +0.10 rad falsifies that magnitude. Its weakest point is incomplete specification of the required telemetry and of progress after treatment-induced termination, where autoresets or survivor filtering could invalidate the contrast.
suggested_changes: Explicitly freeze three cells: incumbent alone, coherent ff/rf pro-direction pulses, and coherent ff/rf anti-direction pulses, with other fingertip requests zero. Log per-step decoder bounds and downstream action clamps, joint targets and motion, fingertip world velocity, pen-surface velocity, and contact impulses for each arm; reuse rolling_decoder_gate instrumentation through scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml.

Predeclare termination handling for the fixed steps 150–209 estimand: integrate only the original episode and assign zero contribution after its termination, excluding all autoreset motion. Keep eligibility determined solely from the zero-cell prefix, with no filtering on pulse-arm survival; verify matching in-play prefixes through step 149 using the already budgeted cells.
Retain seed 4750, the frozen decoder, all existing thresholds, and the 120-episode/0-LLM budget; add no calibration or qualification rollouts.

implementer.reasoning: Agree: right first spend, and I accept all three advisor changes (three frozen cells with other fingertip requests zero; termination handling with zero contribution after the original episode ends and no filtering on pulse-arm survival; seed 4750 and the frozen decoder unchanged, no calibration). My own additions, formed before reading the advisor's: (1) the command's flags do not exist; the real form is 'python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --study transfer_audit' with every constant in a config block; (2) manifest config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_transfer_audit_s4750.yaml by the repo convention; (3) the pulse cells are physical + and - coherent ff/rf circumferential cells, and pro/anti is assigned per case from the zero-cell roll sign over steps 120-149 using contact_control's convention (+circumferential fingertip motion rolls the pen positively about +X); a significantly negative pro-minus-anti is reported as transfer of the opposite sign, not support; (4) the env has no contact sensor, so contact impulses are listed as unavailable, not estimated; (5) in-play prefixes through step 149 must be bit-identical across cells or the audit is void.
